description: Aflac Incorporated was incorporated in 1973 under the laws of the state of Georgia, and together with its subsidiaries provides financial protection to millions of policyholders and customers in Japan and the United States. Its principal business is supplemental health and life insurance products, with the goal of providing customers the best value in supplemental insurance products in Japan and the U.S., paying cash benefits fairly and promptly for eligible claims when a policyholder or insured gets sick or hurt. The Company is authorized to conduct insurance business in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, several U.S. territories and Japan.
